findings.title: Pauschale mit Menge ≠ 1
findings.message: The position lists a quantity of 3 psch for a lump sum, which conflicts with § 7 Abs. 1 VOB/A requiring a single, definitive quantity for lump sums.
findings.suggestion: Adjust quantity to 1 psch or provide a detailed breakdown of the lump sum.

findings.title: Unklare Mengenangabe bei Oberboden laden
findings.message: The quantity 150 m³ for loading and hauling of the upper layer lacks clarification whether it refers to volume of material or work hours.
findings.suggestion: Specify whether the quantity refers to material volume or labor hours and provide unit conversion if necessary.

findings.title: Fehlende Homogenbereichsangabe
findings.message: The description "Boden lösen und profilgerecht ausheben" omits the required Homogenbereich (DIN 18300) for the excavation area.
findings.suggestion: Add Homogenbereich [B1] and corresponding geotechnical data.

findings.title: Fehlende Deponieangabe
findings.message: The disposal of 420 t lacks specification of the authorized landfill and transport details.
findings.suggestion: Include landfill name, address, and transport route.

findings.title: Fehlende Frostschutzklasse
findings.message: The frost protection material specification does not state the frost protection class or depth of application.
findings.suggestion: Add frost protection class (e.g., XC3) and depth.

findings.title: Unbekannte Einheit "Stck/m"
findings.message: The unit "Stck/m" is undefined; likely a typo for "Stk/m²" or "m³".
findings.suggestion: Correct the unit to a standard measurement (e.g., m²).

findings.title: Fehlende Verbindungsteileangabe
findings.message: The pipe delivery description does not specify the type or size of connection fittings required.
findings.suggestion: List connection fittings (e.g., 150 mm couplings).

findings.title: Stückzahl mit Nachkommastellen
findings.message: The quantity 2.5 St is non‑integer, which is atypical for discrete items.
findings.suggestion: Clarify whether 2 St plus half a unit or provide a detailed breakdown.

findings.title: Fehlende Betonklasse und Expositionsklasse
findings.message: The shaft construction lacks specification of concrete class and exposure class.
findings.suggestion: Add C25/30, XC3, etc.

findings.title: Einheit passt nicht zur Leistung
findings.message: The unit m² for concrete placement is inconsistent with the typical unit of m³ for concrete volume.
findings.suggestion: Use m³ and provide density for conversion.

findings.title: Fehlendes Mauerwerksprofil und Lastklasse
findings.message: The masonry description omits the required profile, load class, and width class.
findings.suggestion: Specify KS 17,5 cm, Lastklasse 3, Breitenklasse W09.

findings.title: Fehlende Putzklasse und Oberflächenbeschaffenheit
findings.message: The interior plaster lacks specification of plaster class and finish.
findings.suggestion: Add Putzklasse 1, Oberflächenbeschaffenheit glatt.

findings.title: Fehlende Randdämmstreifenangabe
findings.message: The cement screed description mentions Randdämmstreifen but does not specify dimensions or material.
findings.suggestion: Include width, thickness, and material of Randdämmstreifen.

findings.title: Fehlende Dämmdicke und Wärmeleitfähigkeit
findings.message: The floor insulation lacks thickness and thermal conductivity values.
findings.suggestion: Specify d = 100 mm, WLS = 035.

findings.title: Fehlende Wassereinwirkungsklasse
findings.message: The waterproofing description omits the water exposure class.
findings.suggestion: Add Wassereinwirkungsklasse (z. B. W1).

findings.title: Fehlende Pflasterdimensionen und Fugenbreite
findings.message: The paving description lacks stone dimensions and joint width.
findings.suggestion: Specify stone size (e.g., 20 cm × 20 cm) and Fugenbreite (e.g., 2 mm).

findings.title: Fehlende Asphaltklassifizierung und Verdichtungsparameter
findings.message: The asphalt base layer description lacks class (e.g., AC 20) and compaction details.
findings.suggestion: Add asphalt class, compaction method, and target density.

findings.title: Fehlende Asphaltklassifizierung und Verdichtungsparameter
findings.message: The asphalt top layer description lacks class and compaction details.
findings.suggestion: Add asphalt class, compaction method, and target density.

findings.title: Unplausibel niedriger Preis pro Stunde
findings.message: The price of €0.10 per hour for site cleaning is unrealistically low and likely a typo.
findings.suggestion: Recalculate based on typical labor rates (e.g., €30–€50/h).

findings.title: Pauschale mit Menge ≠ 1
findings.message: Same issue as 2.1.1.10 – lump sum with quantity 1 psch is correct, but duplicate position may cause double billing.
findings.suggestion: Consolidate duplicate positions or clarify distinction.

findings.title: Mögliche Doppelposition mit 2.1.1.60
findings.message: Both positions describe upper layer removal; potential duplication.
findings.suggestion: Verify whether both are necessary or merge.

findings.title: Mögliche Doppelposition mit 2.1.1.30
findings.message: Both positions cover loading and hauling of upper layer; check for redundancy.
findings.suggestion: Clarify scope differences or consolidate.

findings.title: Fehlende Homogenbereichsangabe
findings.message: Same as 2.1.1.40 – missing Homogenbereich.
findings.suggestion: Add Homogenbereich [B1] and geotechnical data.

findings.title: Fehlende Deponieangabe
findings.message: Same as 2.1.1.50 – missing landfill details.
findings.suggestion: Include landfill name and transport route.

findings.title: Fehlende Frostschutzklasse
findings.message: Same as 2.1.1.60 – missing frost protection class.
findings.suggestion: Add frost protection class and depth.
